dimensions.assessment: Individuals investigated or prosecuted for fraud related to specific pandemic unemployment programs are affected.
dimensions.evidence: any criminal prosecution or civil enforcement action ... with respect to any unemployment compensation claim funded in whole or in part by pandemic unemployment assistance

dimensions.assessment: Doubling the statute of limitations from 5 to 10 years significantly extends potential legal liability for fraud offenses.
dimensions.evidence: extends from 5 to 10 years the statute of limitations for federal criminal charges or civil enforcement actions for fraud

dimensions.assessment: The bill rescinds a specific amount of $5,000,000 in unobligated balances.
dimensions.evidence: Out of the unobligated balances ... $5,000,000 are hereby rescinded.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the CARES Act to alter the statute of limitations for specific federal unemployment programs and rescinds specific funds.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the CARES Act to extend the statute of limitations for fraud under certain unemployment programs

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the statute of limitations for covered past and future claims, coupled with an immediate budget rescission.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall take effect on the date of enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total potential funds recovered through extended enforcement are not estimated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends the statute of limitations for pandemic unemployment fraud from 5 to 10 years and rescinds $5 million in unobligated anti-fraud funds.
